svg.title: Communications: customer support and business messaging
svg.desc: Customer conversations on your own provider accounts, with consent, history, and your choice of AI. Answer and reach customers on the right channel, with permission, and know afterward exactly what was sent, what came back, who wrote it, and why each send was allowed. Workflow: Customer writes in, then Conversation opened or reopened, then Person, automation, or allowed AI answers, then Consent and Trust and Safety gate, then Sent from the number they wrote to, then Reply and provenance in history.
